name: Wrightsville Beach Bash 2026

venue.name: Holiday Inn Resort Lumina on Wrightsville Beach by IHG
venue.address: 1706 N Lumina Ave, Wrightsville Beach, NC 28480

information:
**All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WrightsvilleBeachBash2026#66112-competitor-information) prior to registering.**
Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email.

**Due to space limitations, each competitor is only allowed to bring ONE guest with them to the competition.** Yes, parents and siblings count as guests.

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing Inc](https://southeastcubing.org/about)
